# appsignal_dashboard_timeseries (Resource)

A graph of one or more metrics over time on an AppSignal dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_dashboard_timeseries" "queue_depth" {
  app_id       = appsignal_app.web.id
  dashboard_id = appsignal_dashboard.workers.id
  title        = "Queue depth"
  display      = "area"
  line_label   = "%queue%"
  layout       = { x = 0, y = 0, w = 6, h = 4 }
  metrics = [
    { name = "queue_depth", fields = ["gauge"], tags = { queue = "*" } },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `dashboard_id` (String)
- `metrics` (Attributes List) Metrics drawn in the graph, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `display` (String) Line style: line, area, area_relative. Defaults to `line`.
- `draw_null_as_zero` (Boolean) Draw missing data as 0 instead of a gap. Defaults to true, as in AppSignal.
- `format` (String) How values are shown: number, percent, duration, throughput, size. Defaults to `number`.
- `format_input` (String) Unit of the reported value when format is `size`: bit, byte, kilobit, kilobyte, megabyte.
- `layout` (Attributes) Position and size on the dashboard grid. Left out, the graph keeps the place AppSignal or the UI gives it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layout))
- `line_label` (String) Label of each line, with `%name%`, `%field%` and `%<tag>%` replaced. AppSignal uses `%name%` when unset.
- `min_y_axis` (Number) Lowest value on the y axis.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Required:

- `fields` (List of String) Fields to draw: mean, p90, p95, count, gauge, counter.
- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `tags` (Map of String) Tag filters. Values may be `*` to show every value as its own line.


<a id="nestedatt--layout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layout`

Required:

- `h` (Number)
- `w` (Number)
- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_dashboard_timeseries.queue_depth <app_id>/<dashboard_id>/<visual_id>
```
